1951. Salary Calculation Using Method Overriding

60

Medium

Problem Statement

Write a program to demonstrate method overriding using Employee and Manager classes.

Description

Create a superclass named Employee with a method calculateSalary().

Create a subclass named Manager that overrides the method.

Salary Calculation:

Employee Salary = Basic Salary
Manager Salary = Basic Salary + 5000 Bonus
output_spec:
Employee Salary: 30000
Manager Salary: 35000
